purpose: Identify a no-new-subscription route after the owner declined the paid host upgrade; feasibility and bounded next implementation, not a rollout or new accepted candidate.
status: FEASIBLE DIRECTION IDENTIFIED — IMPLEMENTATION AND ACCEPTANCE REQUIRED

financial_constraint.vercel_upgrade: Declined by owner; do not request or purchase again without a changed instruction.
financial_constraint.new_monthly_hosting_subscription: None proposed; reuse existing persistent compute and tunnel.
financial_constraint.cost_limit: Existing electricity, network, database/provider usage and operational limits still apply; no unlimited/free-compute claim.

conclusion: Keep Media and Connect authorization on the existing eligible Hobby deployment. Place the complete Nova resource boundary, including current-grant admission, public projection and terminal persistence, in an isolated process on existing persistent compute. Route nova.galx.ai directly to that boundary, outside any Vercel invocation/rewrite. Use live SSE over the edge, buffering the complete-answer presentation inside the first-party client with explicit bounds.
why_buffering_inside_hobby_fails: Hobby invocation duration remains 300 seconds including response streaming. Waiting, response buffering, heartbeats and waitUntil/after do not add time beyond the invocation deadline.
300 seconds of accepted execution plus terminal database I/O cannot be guaranteed inside a 300-second invocation. Do not lower the accepted deadline to 240/270 seconds as an undocumented workaround.
A 202 response followed by unawaited work in the same invocation still loses its owner when that invocation is reclaimed. A real handoff needs a separately durable authority.

observed_edge_probe.scope: Actual existing edge/tunnel to local synthetic origin. No Vercel candidate invocation, Nova execution, database or provider request.

transport_inference: The current tunnel returned 524 for a silent buffered JSON response after approximately 125 seconds, while the live stream exceeded 300 seconds. Direct placement alone cannot claim unchanged long raw-JSON compatibility. Streaming-first reference clients must assemble complete answers locally.

existing_primitives.sdk: Already separates issuer and resource; invokes the resource directly with a scoped Bearer and stable request ID. Both reference clients currently default to nonstreaming, so they need explicit adaptation.
existing_primitives.nova: Existing invokeNova/ConnectRepository own current-grant authorization, explicit entitlement, shared admission, sanitized projection, terminal persistence and no replay. Move/reuse the entire boundary; do not expose the raw provider runtime as Nova.
existing_primitives.runtime_buffer: Bounded event retention, per-subscriber queues, slow-drain eviction and cursor conflict handling already exist. The ordinary output ring is memory state and is not recovered after restart.
existing_primitives.durable_receipts: An opt-in retained receipt facility already exists, with crash fencing and no replay, but Nova does not request it and its 12000-byte output limit is not a substitute for the existing Nova result contract. Do not silently enable it or promise a new async retrieval API.
existing_primitives.checks: 46 existing isolated checks pass: buffer bounds, owner isolation, retained receipt identity/body bounds, crash fencing and no replay. No new regression code was needed for this source-inspection pass.

proposed_budgets.hobby: Only authorization/consent/token/refresh/revoke and media requests. Existing SDK token/revoke calls have 15000 ms client deadlines. No inference stream or terminal write owned by a Hobby invocation.
proposed_budgets.nova: Keep the 300000 ms execution deadline and existing first-output/idle/output/admission bounds. The persistent host owns bounded terminal I/O after interruption, independent of any Vercel cleanup budget.
proposed_budgets.client_buffer: For a complete-answer UI, request the already-supported SSE representation and accumulate only sanitized content under a reviewed explicit byte limit. Resolve only after confirmed terminal completion; abort/EOF/error retains unknown. No automatic POST retry or synthetic success.
proposed_budgets.capacity: No new entitlement or waiting-room capacity. Preserve two slots per account, twelve admissions/minute and sixty-four shared reservations plus current provider-side limits. Existing buffer caps are not extra compute slots.
proposed_budgets.shutdown: Stop admitting before shutdown and drain/finalize owned requests within their existing deadline plus database limits; abrupt loss must never dispatch again.

minimal_implementation: Package a small Node 22 resource adapter on the existing supervised host, using the accepted Nova helper, current-grant adapter, resource-origin validation and CORS projection. Keep database/access authority isolated from provider desktop/agent execution. Expose only reviewed Nova/resource-metadata routes; control and ownership interfaces remain private.

Prepare a separate Hobby-compatible web output that does not carry a 360-second inference function. Preserve current artifacts; do not just set its host declaration to 300 while leaving the long execution path enabled.

Point only the Nova resource hostname at the authenticated persistent adapter through existing ingress during a separately authorized rollout. Never send long inference back through a Vercel function or unproven rewrite.

Change first-party complete-answer calls to stream internally and buffer locally with cancellation, size and terminal checks. Keep invoke/connection permissions and provider credentials unchanged. Direct raw JSON callers over the tunnel do not inherit a 300-second success guarantee.

Rerun artifact provenance, Node-host request lifetime, full-duration SSE, client aggregation, negative authorization/revocation, shared admission, duplicate/no-replay, shutdown/restart and public-boundary checks before considering ACT-045 closure.

alternative_if_all_requests_must_touch_h.design: Short authenticated submit/read requests with persisted opaque operation references and a separate execution owner on existing compute; e.g. bounded 15-second submission and 20-second read windows are design targets, not measured guarantees.
alternative_if_all_requests_must_touch_h.additional_scope: Requires an explicit Nova-to-worker handoff, durable ownership/idempotency mapping, result retention, owner/grant checks on every read, cancellation and interrupted-reader semantics, plus SDK integration. Current ring buffers and private upstream job IDs cannot be exposed as the public contract.
alternative_if_all_requests_must_touch_h.recommendation: Defer this larger async protocol change; direct scoped Nova streaming with client-side buffering is smaller for the first-party cohort.

acceptance_to_preserve: Same account identity and explicit entitlement plus scoped client grant; ordinary sessions deny.
Acknowledged revocation blocks new admissions and refresh; an already-admitted request retains its existing policy.
Cancellation/deadline/transport loss stay neutral for provider health.
Unknown remains terminal and is never automatically replayed; reconnecting/reading stored output is not permission to recompute.
Only allowlisted public results leave Nova. Provider credentials and private ownership evidence never enter clients.
No quota, pricing, YOLO Pass, identity migration, new routing policy or historical record changes.

remaining.finding: Existing validated web artifact still requires 360 seconds. The described persistent resource adapter, client buffering and compatible web package are not implemented or accepted.

remaining.classification: HOSTING ELIGIBILITY — MUST BE ESTABLISHED BEFORE HOSTED USE
remaining.finding: Vercel documents Hobby as personal non-commercial use only. Technical separation does not establish that GALX qualifies, and private/cohort-only access does not itself settle that question. If this is commercial/institutional use, reuse existing hosting for the web/Connect surface as well or obtain an eligible hosting arrangement; no purchase or migration authorized here.

remaining.classification: NON-BLOCKING FOLLOW-UP FOR A SUPERVISED COHORT
remaining.finding: Existing persistent compute depends on owner-host power, network and supervision. No new availability guarantee or public-launch readiness.

action_status.ACT-044: CLOSED for the retained prior candidate; new packaging must be reaccepted if this proposal is implemented.
action_status.ACT-046: CLOSED for staged disabled configuration; the new resource host will need the same boundary revalidation.

references.claim: 300-second Hobby wall duration includes streamed response time.
waitUntil shares the invocation timeout; timed-out promises are cancelled.
Hobby is restricted to personal non-commercial use.
Origin read timeouts are distinct from request execution duration; actual target probe retained separately.
